'''Witches''' are the spellcasting path — the only one with a fully documented level ladder.



== How to Become One ==
Find a randomly spawning '''Grimoire''' (spellbook) in the woods and hold the '''Make Pact''' prompt. You respawn as a Witch at Lv 0 with a "Witches" badge. No pre-grind needed. You start with Incendia and a passive ability.



== Abilities ==
Witch abilities are separate from spellcasting.
* '''Fists''' (starting) — When Fists are equipped, the user's hand glows with purple magical energy, launching purple magic orbs at targets. Medium range.
* '''R''' — Soul Drain (starting) — Drains the target's soul, levitating them while dealing significant damage; the Witch recovers Health from the damage dealt. (Cooldown: 38 seconds)
* '''F''' — Petrification — Lv 15 (25s cooldown, works on NPCs and players)
* '''Strength''' (chat-cast — type 'strength') — Lv 25 (+20% strength, does not stack, 38s cooldown; empowers an NPC or ally)
* '''V''' — Invisibility — Lv 25 (increased movement speed while invisible; does not make the Witch intangible — still affected by attacks and abilities)
* '''Q''' — Break Neck — Lv 50 (15s cooldown; levitates the target before breaking their neck; players and NPCs)
* '''X''' — Heart Extraction — Lv 100 (90s cooldown; consuming the extracted heart grants one additional life against lethal attacks, protecting from instant kill)
* '''B''' — Pain Infliction — Lv 140 (35s cooldown; if the Witch runs out of Mana while using it, they begin taking damage)
* '''G''' — Telekinesis — Lv 300 (manipulate another player's body from a distance: lift them, move them freely, and throw them far; temporarily immobilizes the target before launching)
* '''J''' — Beam — unlock level unconfirmed (not mentioned in the level guide)
* '''N''' — Push — pushes multiple players. (Level requirement not yet confirmed.)

== Spellcasting ==
Spellcasting uses a Spell Cauldron, not a book.
See [[Witch Spells]] for rituals, spells, and potions.


== Level Ladder ==
* '''Novice''' — 0–24
* '''Adept''' — 25–49
* '''Gifted''' — 50–74
* '''Powerful''' — 75–99
* '''Elder''' — 100–399
* '''Ancient''' — 400–799
* '''Scarce''' — 800+




The highest-level witch on a server also holds the '''Supreme Witch''' title, with +10% magic damage, +10% strength potency and duration, and +10% petrification duration, and no increase to mana cost.




== Magic Cauldron ==
Found inside the Witch House, located in the cemetery. Used to craft items. See [[Witch Spells]] for the spells, potions, and crafted items.
[[File:Witch-magic-cauldron.png|thumb|The Magic Cauldron]]


== Other Notes ==
* Witches can walk in daylight (unlike vampires).
* Gather blue vervain flowers for witch crafting stations.
* '''Broom:''' Sold at the witch's little shop for 15,000 cash. Faster travel for chasing or escaping; low durability, so don't spam it.
* '''Powerful Witch game pass''' (⚠️Trello): 65 Robux — more magic, can see ghosts and revive self.
* '''Clans:''' Witches form covens — the witch version of vampire bloodlines and werewolf packs.


== Strengths and Weaknesses ==
* '''Strengths:''' Ranged spell kit, daylight freedom, clear progression ladder, Supreme Witch bonuses
* '''Weaknesses:''' Magic meter management, spells can backfire at high levels, Grimoire spawns are random
